title: FeatureFlagRegistry
description: Feature-flag registry (planning/14 §11, NFR-OBS-080): every flag declares an owner, purpose, kind, expiry, rollout plan, a safe off state and the value used when the flag provider is unconfigured or unreachable. Flags gate rollout and experiments only, never paid capability (that is an entitlement, planning/12). Keys are stable: retire a flag by removing it with its last check, never rename or reuse a key. packages/shared-kernel/tests also check what a schema cannot express: every owner is a person id in owners.json, expiresAt is after createdAt, and a rollout flag expires at most 90 days after createdAt.

flags.description: Flag key (kebab-case, the provider's flag key) to its declaration

owner.description: Person id from owners.json (a person, not a role or team)

kind.description: rollout: staged release, expires within 90 days; experiment: A/B test, expires; kill-switch: permanent operational off switch (per AI task, provider or pipeline), exempt from expiry and listed in runbook 10

expiresAt.description: Required unless kind is kill-switch; the weekly expired-flag report fails after this date

rolloutPlan.description: Stages and the metric guardrails named for this flag (default: internal → 5% → 25% → 100%)

offBehavior.description: What the product does with the flag off; off must always be a safe rollback

defaultWhenUnavailable.description: Value the FeatureFlags adapter returns when the provider is unconfigured or unreachable
